title: German Speaking Business Development Executive
description:
European Business Development Executive Location: Cheshire East (Hybrid Working)
Salary: £28,000 - £32,000 DOE + Bonus
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Travel: European Travel Required Ready to take your sales career international? Safer Hand Solutions are supporting a growing and ambitious business in the search for a European Business Development Executive to join their expanding European sales team. This is an exciting opportunity for a driven and commercially minded individual who enjoys building relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and helping companies grow within international markets. Whether you have previous B2 B sales experience or are looking to take the next step in your commercial career, this role offers excellent development opportunities and the chance to travel across Europe. The Role As a European Business Development Executive, you will play a key role in expanding the company's presence across European markets by identifying new customers, building strong client relationships, and supporting business growth. Key responsibilities include:
- Generating new business opportunities through outbound sales activity, networking, and industry events.
- Building and developing relationships with distributors and clients across Europe.
- Delivering engaging presentations and tailored commercial proposals.
- Working closely with the European Business Development Manager, sales teams, and marketing colleagues.
- Managing sales pipelines and maintaining accurate CRM records.
- Attending European trade shows, client meetings, and networking events.

What We're Looking For
- Fluent in both German and English (essential).
- Previous experience in B2 B sales, business development, account management, or a customer-facing commercial role would be advantageous.
- Confident communicator with strong relationship-building skills.
- Self-motivated, ambitious, and driven to succeed.
- Comfortable making outbound approaches and developing new business opportunities.
- Willingness to travel throughout Europe when required.
- Additional European language skills would be beneficial but not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £28,000 - £32,000 depending on experience.
- Attractive bonus structure.
- Hybrid working available.
- European travel opportunities.
- Ongoing training and career development.
- Opportunity to join a growing and successful international business.

Interested? If you speak fluent German, enjoy building relationships, and are looking for an exciting opportunity within international business development, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or contact Sean at Safer Hand Solutions for a confidential discussion.

title: Outbound Sales Adviser

description:
Work Lyf Group is currently recruiting for experienced Outbound Sales Advisors to join a thriving and fast-paced sales team based in Crewe. With the busy season approaching, we are looking for motivated and target-driven individuals who enjoy building customer relationships and achieving results.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive team, offering a competitive salary, uncapped commission, ongoing training, and genuine career development opportunities.

Salary

28,840 per annum + Uncapped Commission

Available Shifts

Monday to Friday (40 Hours)

Monday late shift 08:50am - 19:30pm

Tues,Wed,Thurs 08:50am - 17:20pm

Friday 08:50am - 15:20pm

or

The Role

As an Outbound Sales Advisor, you will be responsible for contacting existing and prospective customers, promoting products and services, generating sales opportunities, and delivering exceptional customer service.

Key responsibilities include:
- Making outbound sales calls to existing and potential customers
- Building and maintaining strong customer relationships
- Identifying customer needs and recommending suitable products and services
- Working towards individual and team sales targets
- Managing customer information and call activity through CRM systems

- The ability to work towards targets and KPIs
- Good IT skills, including experience using CRM systems
- A positive attitude and strong team-working ethic

Benefits
- Competitive salary of 28,840
- Uncapped commission structure
- Full training and ongoing coaching
- Supportive and friendly team environment
- Career progression opportunities
- Company benefits package

If you're a motivated sales professional looking to join a growing business and maximise your earning potential, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Advisor
description:
Our client is a growing business with an expanding commercial team and is looking to appoint a motivated Sales Advisor.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous sales, telesales or customer-facing experience who is looking to develop their career within a commercially focused environment. You don't need years of experience. The right attitude, confidence and willingness to learn are just as important.

The role combines customer engagement, relationship building and new business development. You'll speak with prospective and existing customers, understand their requirements, identify opportunities and work towards converting them into new business.

You'll have clear targets and plenty of opportunity to develop your earning potential, with uncapped commission and realistic first-year earnings of 37,000- 45,000.

The role will involve:
- Speaking with customers and prospective clients by telephone
- Identifying and developing new sales opportunities
- Building positive relationships with customers
- Understanding customer requirements and presenting suitable solutions
- Following up opportunities and managing your own pipeline
- Working towards individual activity and revenue targets
- Maintaining consistent levels of sales activity
- Taking ownership of your own performance and development

We're looking for people who are confident, personable and commercially minded. Previous experience in sales, telesales, customer service or another target-driven environment would be useful, but we're also interested in people who have the right personality and attitude to develop within sales.

You'll need to be comfortable speaking to people over the phone, able to build rapport quickly and resilient enough to deal with objections and rejection. Most importantly, you'll need to be motivated by achieving targets and have the ambition to progress.

In return, you'll receive structured support, uncapped commission and a clear opportunity to progress into more senior sales positions as you develop.
- 25,000 basic salary (35-hour working week, Monday-Friday)
- Uncapped commission - 37,000- 45,000 realistic first-year OTE
- Clear progression opportunities
- Supportive, performance-led environment
- Company pension scheme

If you're looking for your next opportunity in sales and want a role where you can develop, earn and progress, we'd be interested in hearing from you.

To apply, contact David at Greys Specialist Recruitment.

title: Junior Account Executive
description:
Our client, a leading conference producer, is recruiting ambitious Junior Account Executives to join its growing commercial team.

This is an opportunity for someone with B2 B sales experience who is hungry to develop their career, build strong client relationships and earn a high OTE. The basic salary is 30,000- 35,000, with realistic earning potential of 70,000- 100,000 per year.

The Person:

You'll ideally have some previous B2 B sales experience and a genuine desire to progress, earn and succeed in a commercially driven environment.

We're particularly interested in people from Events Sales and Media Sales backgrounds. These environments provide strong experience of selling to businesses, building relationships with decision makers and working towards commercial targets.

Pharma and Medical Sales backgrounds are also relevant. You'll already be used to having credible conversations with professional clients, understanding a proposition and developing relationships rather than simply working through a scripted sales process.

We're also open to candidates from other B2 B sales backgrounds. The important thing is that you have the fundamentals of sales, communicate well and have the ambition and commercial drive to develop.

The Role:

You'll be speaking with professional clients and senior decision makers, developing new business and managing opportunities through the sales process. You'll need to be confident picking up the phone, asking the right questions, listening, understanding client requirements, presenting solutions and closing business.

The role will include:
- Developing new B2 B opportunities
- Prospecting and speaking with decision makers
- Building and managing client relationships
- Running sales conversations and presentations
- Understanding client requirements and positioning solutions
- Managing a pipeline of opportunities
- Taking opportunities from initial conversation through to close
- Working towards individual and team targets
- Attending conferences and industry events
- Representing the business professionally with clients and prospects

A large part of the role involves Teams calls and video conferencing, so you'll need to be articulate, confident and professional on camera. You'll also attend conferences and events, representing the business as a brand ambassador and building relationships face-to-face.

We're looking for people who are intelligent, personable, commercially minded and confident in front of clients. You should be comfortable speaking to senior people, able to hold a professional conversation and have the confidence to represent a premium business.

Most importantly, you need to be driven. This is a role where strong sales performance can translate into 70,000- 100,000 per year, so we're looking for people who are motivated by targets, commission and progression.

The role is based near Wilmslow, so access to your own vehicle would be beneficial due to the office location. You will work two days per week in the office and the remainder working remotely. You'll also attend conferences and events as part of the role.
- 30,000- 35,000 basic salary
- 70,000- 100,000 realistic earning potential
- Permanent
- Hybrid, 2 days per week in the office

To apply, contact David at Greys Specialist Recruitment
